glossary.definition: (1) "Small business" has the same meaning as defined by the Code of Federal Regulations, Title 13, Chapter 1, Part 121.
glossary.source_title: Section 119.14 - Waiver of penalties for first-time paperwork offenses.

glossary.definition: (2) "Paperwork violation" means the violation of any statutory or regulatory requirement in the Revised Code mandating the collection of information by a state agency or regulatory body.
glossary.source_title: Section 119.14 - Waiver of penalties for first-time paperwork offenses.

glossary.definition: (3) "First-time offense" means the first instance of a violation of the particular statutory or regulatory requirement mandating the collection of information by a state agency or regulatory body.
glossary.source_title: Section 119.14 - Waiver of penalties for first-time paperwork offenses.
